findings.body: The companion is required only when some relevant coverage is `unconfirmed`. For a range containing a confirmed-complete source month plus a `not_loaded` month, the schema therefore requires only `actual: not_loaded` and rejects an `availableActualSubtotal` as an extra key. This discards the exact source-covered amount and its drill handle, although the confirmed spec says a source-covered range sums available rows while excluding—not zero-filling—missing source months. Require the companion whenever incomplete aggregate coverage still contains source-covered Actual data, and add this mixed complete/not-loaded result case.
findings.title: Not done: partial Actual ranges retain their available subtotal

findings.body: The refinement validates prerequisites only when `percentage.state` is `available`. A result with complete Actual coverage, loaded nonzero Budget, and `percentage: { state: "not_applicable" }` therefore passes unchanged. That permits a requested comparison to suppress its exact ratio despite all inputs being available. Add the inverse requirement and a negative result-validation test: `not_applicable` is valid only when Actual is incomplete, Budget is missing/special, or the loaded denominator is zero.
findings.title: Not done: complete nonzero comparisons cannot claim Not applicable

findings.body: The new mixed-coverage rule forces `availableBudgetSubtotal` onto every row whenever any relevant coordinate is loaded and another is missing. For an Unmapped component row, however, the value contract allows that companion only beside `budget.state === "not_loaded"`, and the later special-state check rejects `budget.state === "unmapped"` whenever any coordinate is not loaded. Consequently an all-my-Plants component result cannot preserve the required exact `No Budget assigned to Unmapped` state under partial Budget coverage; it must either use the generic missing-coverage label or fail validation. Exempt intrinsically budgetless Unmapped rows from the partial companion rule and cover this combination.
findings.title: Not done: mixed Budget coverage retains the Unmapped state

findings.body: `timeWindow.kind === "range"` receives no boundary validation, so inputs such as 2026-04-15 through 2026-05-06 pass the strict query tool schema. The supported periods are complete months, and Budget/Roll-over facts are monthly, so this selection has no defined exact cross-source interpretation and can produce values for a broader scope than its dates claim. Require range `from` to be the first day and `to` the last day of a month, with a negative selection test.
findings.title: Not done: selection validation rejects partial-month ranges

findings.body: Unlike selections and catalog dimension support lists, each catalog combination accepts repeated measure and dimension IDs. A catalog can therefore validate and advertise `measureIds: ["actual", "actual"]` or duplicate grouping dimensions even though the corresponding selection is rejected as invalid. Enforce set semantics within every combination and cover the malformed catalog case.
findings.title: Reject duplicate identifiers inside catalog combinations
